challenge_size.interpretation: Account size must be frozen before replay; no size may be selected after outcomes.

challenge_fee.interpretation: Exact fee and Swing surcharge must be snapshotted for the chosen account size before economic closeout.

profit_target.interpretation: Evaluation target only; no funded target.

stage_count.interpretation: Single evaluation phase before funded account.

daily_drawdown.rule_text: One-Step daily limit is 4% of initial capital; floating PnL, realized PnL and fees are included; reset at UTC.
daily_drawdown.interpretation: Standard and Swing are separate frozen operational variants; HTF study should prioritize Swing without discarding Standard outcomes.

maximum_drawdown.rule_text: Maximum loss 6% on One-Step challenge and funded account.

max_position_size.value: Funded only: total margin across open positions <=25% initial balance; cumulative notional <=2x initial balance
max_position_size.interpretation: Must be checked portfolio-wide against concurrent positions.

leverage.value: Bybit most altcoins 50x-100x; CLEO default 10x adjustable up to 100x
leverage.interpretation: Actual leverage for each setup symbol must be frozen from the selected platform before replay.

inactivity_limit.value: 30 days since most recent trading day; trading day defined by closed trade
inactivity_limit.interpretation: A 40-day max-hold strategy can breach inactivity if no other qualifying close occurs.

consistency_rule.value: During evaluation no single trading day may contribute >40% of total net result; excess contribution is not counted toward target rather than immediate account failure
consistency_rule.interpretation: Challenge target reachability must use counted profit, not raw total PnL.

minimum_trading_days.rule_text: A valid day requires at least one qualifying opened-and-closed trade; trade value >=5% of initial balance and trade PnL magnitude >=1% of trade value.
minimum_trading_days.interpretation: Exact setup trades must be checked for day qualification; no dummy trades may be added.

news_restrictions.value: Solely trading based on news events is prohibited; frozen Donchian setups are not news-event strategies
